# pay-agent

An AI agent that autonomously purchases data from x402-protected APIs using Hedera micropayments, with every payment logged to an immutable HCS audit trail.
Submitted for the Hedera x402 Bounty (hedera.com/x402-bounty).

## Real-World Application: Agentic Commerce Infrastructure

AI agents are becoming autonomous economic actors but lack a payment layer. pay-agent builds that layer: per-request micropayments on Hedera (seconds to settle, $0.0001/tx) with immutable audit trails via HCS.

Industries that need this:
- Algorithmic trading: bots buy data per-query, HCS satisfies SEC/MiFID II compliance
- AI/ML: agents buy training data and inference at $0.001 per call
- Research marketplace: pay-per-access instead of subscriptions
- Supply chain/ESG: auditable chain of custody for compliance data

## Project Structure

- packages/server — Express API server with x402 resource server, AI agent, and HCS audit trail
- packages/web — React (Vite) dashboard

## Key Technologies

- x402 protocol (@x402/express, @x402/core, @x402/fetch, @x402/hedera)
- Hedera testnet (hedera:testnet) — HBAR micropayments, ~$0.0001/tx
- Hedera Consensus Service — immutable audit trail for every x402 payment
- @hiero-ledger/sdk — native Hedera SDK for HCS topic creation and message submission
- Ollama LLM (@langchain/ollama) for agent reasoning
- LangChain for tool orchestration
- x402.org facilitator handles verification and settlement

## Hedera Services

| Service | Usage |
|---------|-------|
| Hedera Token Service (HTS) | Native HBAR transfers for x402 micropayments |
| Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) | Immutable log of every payment event to a topic |
| HashScan | Block explorer for verifying transactions and audit logs |

## x402 Flow

1. Client requests a protected endpoint
2. Server responds with HTTP 402 + payment instructions in headers
3. Client signs a Hedera TransferTransaction using @x402/hedera
4. Client retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
5. Server verifies via x402.org facilitator, settles on Hedera
6. Server responds with data + PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt
7. HCS audit hook logs the payment event (transaction ID, amount, endpoint, timestamp) to an HCS topic

## HCS Audit Trail

Every x402 payment event is submitted as a message to a dedicated HCS topic. This creates an immutable, timestamped ledger of all agent spending.

Topic message format:
```json
{
  "event": "x402_payment",
  "transactionId": "0.0.12345@1234567890.123456789",
  "amount": "100000",
  "token": "HBAR",
  "endpoint": "/api/weather",
  "price": "$0.001",
  "timestamp": "2025-07-19T12:00:00.000Z",
  "hashscan": "https://hashscan.io/testnet/transaction/..."
}
```

Query the HCS topic to retrieve the full audit log — verifiable on HashScan.

## Hedera Details

- Network: hedera:testnet
- USDC Token ID: 0.0.429274 (6 decimals)
- HBAR supported as native token (asset ID 0.0.0)
- Facilitator: https://x402.org/facilitator (supports hedera:testnet)
- Block explorer: https://hashscan.io/testnet

## x402 SDK Reference

Server-side:
- paymentMiddleware() from @x402/express wraps Express routes
- ExactHederaScheme from @x402/hedera/exact/server for Hedera settlement
- x402ResourceServer + HTTPFacilitatorClient from @x402/core/server

Client-side:
- createClientHederaSigner from @x402/hedera for signing payments
- ExactHederaScheme from @x402/hedera/exact/client for client-side signing
- wrapFetchWithPayment from @x402/fetch to auto-handle 402 responses
- x402Client from @x402/core/client to register payment schemes

HCS:
- @hiero-ledger/sdk Client.createTopic() to create the audit topic
- @hiero-ledger/sdk TopicMessageSubmitTransaction to log events
- TopicMessageQuery to read back audit entries

## Environment Variables

HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID — Hedera testnet account ID (e.g. 0.0.12345)
HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY — ECDSA private key for the account
HCS_TOPIC_ID — HCS topic ID for the audit trail (created on first run if not set)
OLLAMA_BASE_URL — Ollama server URL (default: http://localhost:11434)
OLLAMA_MODEL — Model to use (default: llama3.2:3b)
PORT — Server port (default: 4021)
FACILITATOR_URL — x402 facilitator URL (default: https://x402.org/facilitator)
